title: Add ions
story: Lysozyme has a net charge of +8, and the simulation needs a neutral system. First build ions.tpr from ions.mdp, 1AKI_solv.gro and topol.top with grompp. Then use genion to swap waters for chloride ions until the charge is zero, writing 1AKI_solv_ions.gro and updating topol.top.

lesson.title: Answering genion with a pipe

parts.note: genion asks which group of molecules it may replace. The pipe sends the answer, SOL (the waters), as if you typed it.
genion reads the run input file that grompp made.
New coordinates, and the topology updated with the ions.
The names of the positive and negative ions.
Add just enough ions to make the total charge zero.

lesson.why: grompp first combines the settings (.mdp), coordinates (.gro) and topology (.top) into one run input file (.tpr), which is what the other tools read.

files.~/{{dir}}/ions.mdp:
; ions.mdp - used as input into grompp to generate ions.tpr
integrator  = steep         ; Algorithm (steep = steepest descent minimization)
emtol       = 1000.0        ; Stop minimization when the maximum force < 1000.0 kJ/mol/nm
emstep      = 0.01          ; Minimization step size
nsteps      = 50000         ; Maximum number of (minimization) steps to perform
nstlist         = 1
cutoff-scheme   = Verlet
ns_type         = grid
coulombtype     = cutoff
rcoulomb        = 1.0
rvdw            = 1.0
pbc             = xyz
files.~/{{dir}}/minim.mdp:
; minim.mdp - used as input into grompp to generate em.tpr
integrator  = steep         ; Algorithm (steep = steepest descent minimization)
emtol       = 1000.0        ; Stop minimization when the maximum force < 1000.0 kJ/mol/nm
emstep      = 0.01          ; Minimization step size
nsteps      = 50000         ; Maximum number of (minimization) steps to perform
nstlist         = 1
cutoff-scheme   = Verlet
coulombtype     = PME
rcoulomb        = 1.0
rvdw            = 1.0
pbc             = xyz
